label: FAQ
html:
Got Questions?

Answers to everything

Are these offers actually free? +

Many offers are completely free — no credit card required. Some include free trials that auto-renew after the trial period; we always disclose this clearly before you click. You're never surprised by charges.

How do you verify offers before listing them? +

Our team manually tests every offer — creating accounts, applying discounts, and confirming the product delivers what's advertised. We also remove any offer with an expiry within 48 hours so you never land on a dead deal.

How does TopDeals Hub make money? +

We earn a referral commission when you claim an offer and make a purchase. This comes from the partner company — not from you. Our recommendations are never pay-to-play; they're based purely on quality and user reviews.

Is my personal information safe? +

Absolutely. We are fully GDPR and CCPA compliant. We never sell your data to third parties. You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting our support team.

Can I get a refund if I'm not happy? +

Refund policies are set by each individual partner. We clearly display refund terms on every offer card. Most of our featured offers include a 30-day money-back guarantee, and we only feature partners with strong refund track records.
